title: M3 review follow-ups before M4/daemon
description: Deferred minors from M3 review: (1) non-JSON claude output should say cost unknown, not $0.00; (2) per-repo clone lock is in-process only — add flock on repos/<owner>/<name>.lock before any daemon/second process; (3) key cache on canonical pr.Repo, not user-typed repo; (4) clearer error when PR head changed between GetPR and fetch; (5) print 'no cap' when max_cost_per_review_usd unset; (6) decide whether request_changes requires a blocking comment (M4); (7) accept www.github.com URLs. See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-09-m3-agent-dry-run.md.
